data.name: AI Code Review Platform
data.description: 🛡️ Problem: Manual code reviews frequently miss subtle security vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, and error handling oversights during rapid release cycles. | Solution: Built an automated dual-pass review pipeline combining AST-level static security analysis (Semgrep & Bandit) with a context-aware LLM pass (Groq LLaMA 3) via FastAPI. | Impact: Automatically posts structured, vulnerability-annotated review summaries directly to GitHub Pull Requests, accelerating PR triage cycles. <!-- TODO: Add specific PR review time reduction percentage or scanned repository count -->

data.name: ClipForge — AI Video-Clipping Pipeline
data.description: 🎬 Problem: Converting long-form podcast and video content into viral vertical shorts requires hours of manual editing and subtitle syncing. | Solution: Engineered a distributed asynchronous video pipeline (FastAPI, Celery, Redis) that transcribes via faster-whisper, evaluates virality with Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B, renders 9:16 cuts with word-level kinetic ASS captions via FFmpeg, and uploads to Cloudflare R2. | Impact: Fully automates long-form ingestion to scheduled YouTube Shorts publication in under 3 minutes per cut. <!-- TODO: Add total videos rendered or processing time benchmark -->

data.name: DevArchitect AI — Coding Assistant
data.description: ⚡ Problem: Developers require low-latency, context-aware architectural feedback and code generation without exposing API credentials client-side. | Solution: Developed a real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) AI coding assistant in FastAPI and TypeScript backed by the Anthropic Claude API, featuring token streaming, structured multi-turn conversation memory, and server-side key security. | Impact: Delivers instant sub-second token streaming responses for complex codebase design discussions and multi-file code refactoring. <!-- TODO: Add active user count or request throughput -->

data.name: AI Resume Analyzer
data.description: 🤖 Problem: Job applicants face high ATS rejection rates due to unoptimized keyword alignment, poor formatting, and unquantified accomplishments. | Solution: Architected an intelligent evaluation platform (FastAPI & Claude API) that parses PDF/text resumes, scores candidates (0–100) across 5 core dimensions, detects missing technical keywords against target job roles, and generates actionable improvements. | Impact: Evaluates and grades resumes in under 5 seconds with granular dimension scoring and ATS optimization feedback. <!-- TODO: Add resume processing count or ATS match rate increase -->

data.name: JobFinder v3.0 (scraper3.0)
data.description: ⚡ Problem: Dispersed job listings across regional and global job boards lead to missed opportunities, stale data, and duplicate applications. | Solution: Built a high-concurrency async scraping and aggregation engine in Python (FastAPI, httpx, asyncio) querying 24 regional (Pakistan & GCC) and global job portals simultaneously, leveraging Groq LLM for semantic query expansion and rapidfuzz for deduplication. | Impact: Aggregates and deduplicates hundreds of real-time listings per query in seconds with zero rate-limit blocks. <!-- TODO: Add total jobs indexed per scrape run -->

data.name: Real-Time Drowsiness Detection System
data.description: 👁️ Problem: Driver fatigue and microsleep episodes are primary contributors to commercial transit collisions and road accidents. | Solution: Implemented a real-time computer vision monitoring pipeline in Python and OpenCV calculating Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) across 68 facial landmarks from live video streams. | Impact: Triggers instantaneous audio-visual fatigue alerts when eye closure exceeds safety thresholds at 30+ FPS real-time processing. <!-- TODO: Add detection accuracy metric percentage -->

data.name: ANPR — Automatic Number Plate Recognition
data.description: 🚗 Problem: Manual vehicle logging at security checkpoints and toll plazas causes severe traffic congestion and recording errors. | Solution: Developed an end-to-end vision pipeline combining YOLOv8 for vehicle and license plate bounding-box localization with OpenCV preprocessing and OCR alphanumeric character extraction. | Impact: Achieves real-time plate localization and text extraction from high-speed video feeds across diverse lighting conditions. <!-- TODO: Add plate recognition accuracy percentage -->

data.name: WhatsApp MapFinder
data.description: 📍 Problem: B2B sales development teams spend substantial manual hours locating and validating regional businesses that lack web presence. | Solution: Engineered a headless browser automation engine using Playwright, FastAPI, and Node.js that parses Google Maps listings across targeted locales, filtering businesses operating without digital sites and extracting validated contact records. | Impact: Extracts and normalizes hundreds of high-intent business leads per query for rapid agency client outreach. <!-- TODO: Add verified leads generated per run -->

data.name: WhatsApp Bulk Sender
data.description: 📨 Problem: Small enterprises need reliable group notification dispatching without incurring expensive enterprise API subscription tiers. | Solution: Created an automated communication utility with Node.js, Express, and whatsapp-web.js featuring live QR code session pairing, randomized queue pacing intervals, and a web dashboard for dispatch management. | Impact: Enables dependable scheduled notification delivery across client contact lists with real-time dispatch monitoring. <!-- TODO: Add total messages dispatched or delivery rate percentage -->
